# Naani Projects

> Naani Projects helps you find the right property in Hyderabad — apartments, villas, gated communities, luxury homes and investment options — smarter and faster on WhatsApp.

Naani Projects is a Hyderabad-focused real estate discovery platform. Buyers share location, budget and preferences on WhatsApp and receive curated, RERA-compliant project options from trusted builders such as Rajapushpa, Prestige, Godrej, Brigade, Candeur, Team4 and Tridasa.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Find the right property in Hyderabad, smarter and faster on WhatsApp.
- [Projects](/projects): Browse premium apartments, villas and gated communities across Hyderabad.
- [About Us](/about-us): Who we are, how we work and why buyers trust Naani Projects.
- [Contact Us](/contact-us): Smart inquiry form and direct WhatsApp/call to our property advisors.
